_readme: Amora's own words for the founding-team application (/propose-a-role), Phase A, 11 Nov 2026. Nothing loads this file at boot. Each value is a village setting under Admin, Game Mechanics, The founding team, applied by hand there or with PUT /api/admin/variables/<key>. Sources: the role-process build list (sections 1.12, 6.7, 7.1, 7.2, 7.5), the lead's rulings of 11 Nov evening (the 40/55/5 placeholder shares, Technical Operations as an onboarding conversation), and traceability point T68 (the plain word on risk). The shares are a design placeholder and never anyone's pay. A setting left out here keeps the platform default.
org.founding_know_us:
Attend the webinar / community call (live, or watch the recording)
Come on a land tour (weekly, right after the potluck)
Join the potluck
org.founding_know_us_note: We encourage you to do these, but if you haven't, you can still apply, especially if you've been invited to, or if you're not in Costa Rica and the next webinar is more than a week away, or if you feel you're an incredibly strong candidate.
org.founding_comp_cash_words: Paid in US dollars: about half or less of total compensation, aligned with Costa Rican pay.
org.founding_comp_equity_words: Intended equity in the Amora entity we are forming together. It is bought, then staked or locked to access land, so it counts toward your lot and your lease.
org.founding_comp_credits_words: Amora Credits, coming soon: usage credits for village offerings.
org.founding_comp_notes:
Amora tokens are yet to be defined. Right now they track contributions that are unpaid, and will later convert to equity, land credits, or a mix of the two as we work this out.
A tools and equipment allowance where the role needs one.
AI support: an AI companion that saves the role time.
Value in, value out: total compensation moves with what you contribute, and there is no fixed cap.
org.founding_comp_at_risk: We want to be plain with you: the equity, credits and tokens are at risk. They hold value only if Amora succeeds. If it does, they buy land here at a discount.
org.founding_comp_footer: Indicative only. Equity, land credit, token and credit terms are still being defined and are subject to legal review.
org.founding_first_cycle: Your first cycle is one paid month, from the end of November to the end of December. At its end, either of us may choose to stop there, with thanks.
org.founding_first_conversations: Technical Operations: your accounts, your tools and the systems you will work in
